title: Speaker McCarthy Has Lost Control of His House

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店里用黑胶唱片打碟的那个年代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，展示着那些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼带来的《重塑者》吧。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Ever since Republicans won a razor-thin majority in the House of Representatives last year,
sentences.zh: 自从去年共和党人在众议院赢得微弱多数席位以来，

sentences.en: there have been predictions that a small group of far-right members would make the chamber ungovernable.
sentences.zh: 一直有人预测，一小群极右翼成员会让众议院陷入无法治理的境地。

sentences.en: Over the past few weeks, that prediction has proven correct.
sentences.zh: 过去几周的情况证明，这一预测是正确的。

sentences.en: My colleague, Annie Carney, explains.
sentences.zh: 我的同事安妮·卡尼将对此进行解读。

sentences.en: Tuesday, June 27th.
sentences.zh: 6月27日，星期二。

sentences.en: Annie, it is very nice to see you and welcome back.
sentences.zh: 安妮，很高兴见到你，欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: Happy to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: We wanted to talk to you because over the past couple of weeks, something started happening in Congress that we wanted to better understand.
sentences.zh: 我们想和你聊聊，因为在过去几周里，国会发生了一些我们想要深入了解的事情。

sentences.en: Lawmakers from both parties, Democrats, Republicans, had just passed this big last-minute deal to avoid a U.S.
sentences.zh: 两党的议员，无论是民主党人还是共和党人，刚刚通过了一项最后一刻的大型协议，以避免美国

sentences.en: financial default on its debt.
sentences.zh: 债务违约。

sentences.en: Everybody breathed a sigh of relief.
sentences.zh: 大家都松了一口气。

sentences.en: And then, right after that, strange things started to happen within the Republican-controlled House.
sentences.zh: 然而紧接着，在共和党控制的众议院内部，奇怪的事情开始发生了。

sentences.en: So, pick up the story there and tell us about that.
sentences.zh: 那么，请从那里开始讲起，告诉我们发生了什么。

sentences.en: What's been happening is that over the last few weeks, Kevin McCarthy, the Speaker of the House, has basically lost control of his chamber.
sentences.zh: 过去几周发生的事情是，众议院议长凯文·麦卡锡基本上已经失去了对众议院的控制。

sentences.en: After he cut the debt ceiling deal with President Biden, he received a lot of blowback from far-right members of his conference, the Freedom Caucus,
sentences.zh: 在他与拜登总统达成债务上限协议后，他遭到了党内极右翼成员——“自由党团”的强烈抵制，

sentences.en: who are livid that he didn't follow through on promises he made to them, specifically on spending cuts.
sentences.zh: 他们对麦卡锡没有兑现承诺——特别是削减开支的承诺——感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And basically feel like they got rolled at this whole process.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上觉得自己在整个过程中被耍了。

sentences.en: You know, they're aware that they have a ton of power in this dynamic of the House, where there is a four-seat majority,
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们很清楚自己在众议院这种只有四个席位多数的动态中拥有巨大的权力，

sentences.en: and they think they have a power-sharing agreement with Kevin McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 而且他们认为自己与凯文·麦卡锡达成了权力分享协议。

sentences.en: So, after that debt deal, where they feel like they were sold out, they used that power to get back at Speaker McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 所以，在那次债务协议之后，他们觉得自己被出卖了，于是利用这种权力来报复麦卡锡议长。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: And how do they get back at him?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么报复他的呢？

sentences.en: They could have tried to get rid of him, called a snap vote on the House floor to remove him as Speaker.
sentences.zh: 他们本可以试图罢免他，在众议院发起突击投票来撤销他的议长职务。

sentences.en: They chose not to do that.
sentences.zh: 但他们选择了不这样做。

sentences.en: Instead, they did something that's arguably more painful and could be a more ongoing torture of the Speaker.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们做了一件可以说更痛苦、更能让议长长期受折磨的事情。

sentences.en: And what is that painful, ongoing torture?
sentences.zh: 那这种痛苦的、长期的折磨是什么呢？

sentences.en: What these far-right members of the House did was they shut down the floor of the House.
sentences.zh: 这些众议院极右翼成员所做的是封锁了众议院议事厅。

sentences.en: On June 6th, they create this blockade that makes it impossible for Republicans to bring a bill to the floor for a vote.
sentences.zh: 6月6日，他们制造了这种封锁，使得共和党人无法将任何法案提交到议事厅进行投票。

sentences.en: Well, just explain that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，解释一下这个。

sentences.en: I mean, how do you blockade the House floor?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你怎么封锁众议院议事厅？

sentences.en: This gets a little in the weeds, but it's fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这有点复杂，但非常引人入胜。

sentences.en: For a bill to get a vote on the floor, first the House has to pass a rule.
sentences.zh: 一项法案要进入议事厅投票，首先众议院必须通过一项规则。

sentences.en: Typically, no one pays attention to a rule vote.
sentences.zh: 通常，没人会关注规则投票。

sentences.en: It's just a procedural measure, and it's just a party-line vote.
sentences.zh: 这只是一项程序性措施，而且通常是按党派立场投票。

sentences.en: So, the adage is, vote party on the rule, vote your conscience on the bill.
sentences.zh: 所以，有一句格言：规则投票看党派，法案投票凭良心。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: But what happened here was these far-right members, who wanted to block the floor, voted with Democrats to bring down the rule.
sentences.zh: 但这里发生的情况是，这些想要封锁议事厅的极右翼成员，与民主党人联手否决了这项规则。

sentences.en: If the rule doesn't pass, the bill can't come to the floor.
sentences.zh: 如果规则没通过，法案就无法提交到议事厅。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: Wait, Republicans vote with Democrats, that's very unexpected, in order to knock down the rule vote, in order to then keep anything from being introduced on the floor.
sentences.zh: 等等，共和党人与民主党人投票，这非常出人意料，目的是为了否决规则投票，从而阻止任何议案被提交到议事厅。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that completely freezes the floor.
sentences.zh: 这完全冻结了议事厅的运作。

sentences.en: That means that they are standing in the way of the Republican agenda, and it's at a standstill.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们阻碍了共和党的议程，一切都陷入了停滞。

sentences.en: Well, McCarthy had meetings all day with these members who were on strike, basically, and at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡整天都在与这些罢工的成员开会，而在一天结束时，

sentences.en: they ended up canceling a whole week of floor action and basically sending people home because there was no agreement.
sentences.zh: 他们最终取消了整整一周的议事活动，基本上让大家回家了，因为没有达成任何协议。

sentences.en: So, House Republicans decide to punish their own leader by making it impossible for anything to happen on the House floor, including anything by their own party, I assume.
sentences.zh: 所以，众议院共和党人决定惩罚他们自己的领袖，让众议院议事厅无法进行任何工作，我想这包括他们自己党派的任何议案。

sentences.en: They're just shutting it down.
sentences.zh: 他们就是直接把它关停了。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, how does this blockade end?
sentences.zh: 那么，这场封锁是如何结束的？

sentences.en: The way the blockade ends is not with some big agreement that means this will never happen again.
sentences.zh: 这场封锁的结束并不是因为达成了什么大协议，保证以后再也不会发生这种事。

sentences.en: The blockade ends on the terms of the Freedom Caucus members.
sentences.zh: 封锁是按照“自由党团”成员的条件结束的。

sentences.en: They end it because there was a bill they felt very passionate about and needed to pass.
sentences.zh: 他们结束封锁是因为有一个他们非常关心的法案需要通过。

sentences.en: It was a gun-related, conservative issue that they really liked.
sentences.zh: 那是一个他们非常喜欢的、与枪支相关的保守派议题。

sentences.en: So, they ended it on their terms, and they made it very clear they weren't removing this threat that they can shut down the House floor for a day, a week, as long as they want.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们按自己的条件结束了封锁，并且明确表示他们并没有放弃这种威胁，即他们可以随时封锁众议院议事厅一天、一周，或者他们想封锁多久就封锁多久。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, Annie, that's the first major episode in this post-debt ceiling, I guess we could call it, mutiny by hard right House Republicans,
sentences.zh: 那么，安妮，这是债务上限之后——我想我们可以称之为——众议院极右翼共和党人叛乱的第一个重大事件，

sentences.en: and it very much undermines Speaker McCarthy's authority.
sentences.zh: 这在很大程度上削弱了麦卡锡议长的权威。

sentences.en: So, what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: What happens next is they find another way to disobey McCarthy and sort of disrupt his control of the floor, which is by using something that's known as a privileged resolution.
sentences.zh: 接下来发生的是，他们找到了另一种违抗麦卡锡并扰乱他对议事厅控制的方法，那就是使用一种被称为“特权决议”的东西。

sentences.en: This is a tool that any member can use that basically allows you to introduce a resolution, and it goes around the speaker.
sentences.zh: 这是一种任何议员都可以使用的工具，基本上允许你提出一项决议，从而绕过议长。

sentences.en: It bypasses any committee work and floor schedule that the leadership controls, and it just allows you to bring this resolution directly to the floor.
sentences.zh: 它绕过了领导层控制的任何委员会工作和议事日程，直接允许你将这项决议提交到议事厅。

sentences.en: Right, because normally a resolution has to go through a series of bureaucratic steps, basically an approval process before it gets anywhere near the House floor.
sentences.zh: 对，因为通常一项决议在进入众议院议事厅之前，必须经过一系列官僚步骤，基本上是一个审批过程。

sentences.en: But you're saying that this thing called a privileged resolution allows a House member to basically skip all those steps, go rogue.
sentences.zh: 但你是说，这个所谓的“特权决议”允许众议院议员基本上跳过所有这些步骤，自行其是。

sentences.en: And I'm guessing that this tool has been around for a while, but that its use is deeply frowned upon.
sentences.zh: 我猜这个工具已经存在一段时间了，但它的使用受到极大的排斥。

sentences.en: This has been around for a while, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，它已经存在一段时间了。

sentences.en: And McCarthy has pleaded with his members, don't use these to try and control the agenda on the floor.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡曾恳求他的成员们，不要利用这些来试图控制议事厅的议程。

sentences.en: And he said to them, part of what we agreed during the fraught speaker's race was a return to regular order.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们，我们在那场艰难的议长选举中达成的一项共识就是回归常规程序。

sentences.en: This is not regular order.
sentences.zh: 这不是常规程序。

sentences.en: Regular order means going through committees.
sentences.zh: 常规程序意味着要经过委员会。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean just bringing up something on your own that you want to do and forcing a vote on it.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着你可以随心所欲地提出你想做的事情，并强行进行投票。

sentences.en: But a lot of these pleas he does in these conference meetings every week really fall on deaf ears.
sentences.zh: 但他每周在这些党团会议上所做的许多恳求，真的都被当成了耳边风。

sentences.en: Mr. Speaker, pursuant to Clause 2A1 of Rule 9, I seek recognition to give notice of my intent to raise a question of privileges of the House.
sentences.zh: 议长先生，根据规则第9条第2A1款，我请求发言，以通知我打算提出一个关于众议院特权的问题。

sentences.en: So on June 13th, a Republican lawmaker named Anna Paulina Luna, she's a freshman from Florida, part of the Freedom Caucus,
sentences.zh: 所以在6月13日，一位名叫安娜·保利娜·卢纳的共和党议员，她是来自佛罗里达州的一年级议员，也是“自由党团”的成员，

sentences.en: uses one of these privileged resolutions to try and censure Adam Schiff.
sentences.zh: 利用这些特权决议之一，试图谴责亚当·希夫。

sentences.en: Ethics that Representative Schiff lied, made representations and abused sensitive information.
sentences.zh: 道德委员会认为希夫众议员撒了谎，进行了虚假陈述并滥用了敏感信息。

sentences.en: Adam Schiff is the former Democratic chairman of the House Intelligence Committee who gained a lot of fame and hatred on the right because he was the lead prosecutor in Trump's first impeachment trial.
sentences.zh: 亚当·希夫是众议院情报委员会的前民主党主席，他在右翼中获得了很大的名声和仇恨，因为他是特朗普第一次弹劾审判的首席检察官。

sentences.en: So he's long been a Republican political target.
sentences.zh: 所以他长期以来一直是共和党的政治目标。

sentences.en: But now Luna decides that she wants to censure him.
sentences.zh: 但现在卢纳决定她要谴责他。

sentences.en: For conduct that misleads the American people in a way that is not.
sentences.zh: 因为其行为误导了美国人民，其方式是不正当的。

sentences.en: For falsely claiming that there is evidence of collusion between Trump campaign and Russia and the first impeachment.
sentences.zh: 因为他虚假声称特朗普竞选团队与俄罗斯之间存在勾结，以及在第一次弹劾中（的行为）。

sentences.en: And she decides to fine him.
sentences.zh: 她决定对他处以罚款。

sentences.en: Sixteen million dollars.
Sixteen million dollars.
Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: A figure she says she comes up with because it's half the cost of what that impeachment trial coSt.
sentences.zh: 她说这个数字是她想出来的，因为这相当于那次弹劾审判成本的一半。

sentences.en: And the Committee on Ethics shall conduct an investigation into Representative Adam Schiff's lies, misrepresentations and abuses of sensitive information.
sentences.zh: 道德委员会应就亚当·希夫众议员的谎言、虚假陈述和滥用敏感信息的行为进行调查。

sentences.en: OK, wow.
sentences.zh: 好吧，哇。

sentences.en: And just as a reminder, Annie, a censure is a rare and a very public form of rebuke.
sentences.zh: 安妮，提醒一下，谴责是一种罕见且非常公开的斥责形式。

sentences.en: It's kind of like an official scolding from Congress.
sentences.zh: 这有点像是来自国会的正式训斥。

sentences.en: And here you're saying that already severe measure, it sounds like, is being paired with a very severe financial fine that might bankrupt your average congressperson.
sentences.zh: 而你刚才说，这种已经很严厉的措施，听起来还伴随着一笔非常沉重的经济罚款，这可能会让普通的国会议员破产。

sentences.en: Yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: However, the House has only censured two other people in the last two decades.
sentences.zh: 然而，众议院在过去二十年里只谴责过另外两个人。

sentences.en: And these were for much more concrete and serious issues.
sentences.zh: 而且那些是因为更具体、更严重的问题。

sentences.en: They censured Paul Gosar, a Republican from Arizona, a few years ago for tweeting out violent depictions of himself striking Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez with a sword.
sentences.zh: 他们几年前谴责了亚利桑那州的共和党人保罗·戈萨，因为他在推特上发布了自己用剑攻击亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯的暴力画面。

sentences.en: And then Charlie Rangel, the former Democratic congressman from New York, was censured for serious financial and campaign misconduct.
sentences.zh: 然后是前纽约州民主党众议员查理·兰格，他因严重的财务和竞选不当行为受到谴责。

sentences.en: Those are the only two examples in the past 20 years.
sentences.zh: 这是过去20年里仅有的两个例子。

sentences.en: And now this one, which really seems to be politically motivated as payback from a Trump loyalist against a person who has long been a political target, especially for Trump.
sentences.zh: 而现在这个，看起来确实是出于政治动机，是特朗普的忠实拥护者对一个长期以来的政治目标——特别是对特朗普而言——的报复。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And what's the reaction from Speaker McCarthy to this resolution, which, as you've described it, is intended to go around him?
sentences.zh: 那么麦卡锡议长对这项决议的反应是什么？正如你所描述的，这项决议旨在绕过他。

sentences.en: Well, even before she brings it up, he is trying to talk her out of it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，甚至在她提出之前，他就在试图劝阻她。

sentences.en: That's what people I spoke with told me.
sentences.zh: 这就是我采访的人告诉我的。

sentences.en: He tries to convince her, you're doing Schiff a huge favor here.
sentences.zh: 他试图说服她，你这样做是在帮希夫一个大忙。

sentences.en: You might end up helping elect him to the Senate.
sentences.zh: 你最终可能会帮他当选参议员。

sentences.en: He's currently running for California Senate seat.
sentences.zh: 他目前正在竞选加利福尼亚州的参议员席位。

sentences.en: Do this through a committee.
sentences.zh: 通过委员会来做这件事吧。

sentences.en: Like, that's regular order.
sentences.zh: 那才是常规程序。

sentences.en: Don't do this.
sentences.zh: 别这么做。

sentences.en: The other argument they make to her is this doesn't have the votes.
sentences.zh: 他们对她提出的另一个论点是，这根本没有足够的票数。

sentences.en: They're pretty convinced that she can't pass this, especially with that $16 million fine,
sentences.zh: 他们相当确信她无法通过这项决议，特别是加上那1600万美元的罚款，

sentences.en: which is something that a lot of Republicans actually opposed finding a member of Congress in that manner.
sentences.zh: 很多共和党人实际上反对以这种方式惩罚国会议员。

sentences.en: But she expressed great confidence that she had the votes.
sentences.zh: 但她表现出极大的信心，认为自己有足够的票数。

sentences.en: She's on the warpath.
sentences.zh: 她正处于战斗状态。

sentences.en: So what happens that day is it actually does fail.
sentences.zh: 所以那天发生的事情是，它确实失败了。

sentences.en: And it looks like she really miscalculated.
sentences.zh: 看起来她真的算错了。

sentences.en: And lots of, I think, 20 Republicans voted against it to block the resolution.
sentences.zh: 我想有20名共和党人投票反对它，以阻止该决议。

sentences.en: So as McCarthy has predicted, it doesn't succeed.
sentences.zh: 所以正如麦卡锡所预料的那样，它没有成功。

sentences.en: It doesn't succeed.
sentences.zh: 它没有成功。

sentences.en: And this is a little example right here of his loss of control.
sentences.zh: 这正是他失去控制的一个小例子。

sentences.en: This is a waste of time on the House floor.
sentences.zh: 这是在众议院议事厅浪费时间。

sentences.en: It's a bit of an embarrassment for the whole team here, including McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 这对整个团队来说有点尴尬，包括麦卡锡。

sentences.en: Adam Schiff, meanwhile, is sending out fundraising email after fundraising email.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，亚当·希夫正在发出一封又一封的筹款邮件。

sentences.en: I'm the number one target.
sentences.zh: 我是头号目标。

sentences.en: And I heard a lot of hand-wringing from moderate Republicans saying, we don't like Adam Schiff either.
sentences.zh: 我听到许多温和派共和党人忧心忡忡地说，我们也不喜欢亚当·希夫。

sentences.en: And we're making an in-kind donation to his Senate campaign here.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在是在给他的参议院竞选捐款。

sentences.en: In other words, they felt this was not only a bit of an embarrassing breakdown of the system, but just politically kind of stupid.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他们觉得这不仅是体制上令人尴尬的崩溃，而且在政治上也很愚蠢。

sentences.en: Politically stupid.
sentences.zh: 政治上的愚蠢。

sentences.en: So they're frustrated on multiple levels by this ploy.
sentences.zh: 所以他们对这种策略在多个层面上感到沮丧。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: But Luna is not deterred by this failure.
sentences.zh: 但卢纳并没有被这次失败所阻挡。

sentences.en: In fact, she tweets out that she's playing four-dimensional chess, and this is all part of her grand plan.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她在推特上说她在下四维棋，这一切都是她宏伟计划的一部分。

sentences.en: And McCarthy's House leadership works with her to figure out a way to make this resolution actually work.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡的众议院领导层与她合作，想办法让这项决议真正发挥作用。

sentences.en: What that means is dropping the $16 million fine.
sentences.zh: 这意味着取消那1600万美元的罚款。

sentences.en: And then they get behind it, and McCarthy supports it, and she's back on the floor with her privileged resolution to censure Adam Schiff.
sentences.zh: 然后他们支持了它，麦卡锡也支持了它，她带着她的特权决议回到了议事厅，要求谴责亚当·希夫。

sentences.en: And this time...
sentences.zh: 而这一次……

sentences.en: The yeas are 213, and the nays are 209.
sentences.zh: 赞成票213票，反对票209票。

sentences.en: It passes along party lines, and they officially do censure a member for the third time in two decades.
sentences.zh: 它按党派立场通过了，他们正式在二十年内第三次谴责了一名议员。

sentences.en: The House will be in order.
sentences.zh: 众议院请保持秩序。

sentences.en: It was a kind of dramatic moment on the House floor where Democrats started chanting, shame, shame, shame from the well.
sentences.zh: 那是众议院议事厅里一个戏剧性的时刻，民主党人开始在议事厅中央高呼：羞耻，羞耻，羞耻。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So thinking back to where we began, McCarthy could not prevent that embarrassing legislative blockade.
sentences.zh: 回想一下我们开始的地方，麦卡锡无法阻止那次尴尬的立法封锁。

sentences.en: He couldn't stop the ultimate censoring of Adam Schiff, even though he originally tries to.
sentences.zh: 他无法阻止最终对亚当·希夫的谴责，尽管他最初试图这样做。

sentences.en: It sounds like the best he can do in this new world in which far-right Republicans are openly rebelling against him is to kind of guide something that he hates into something that he hates less.
sentences.zh: 听起来，在这个极右翼共和党人公开反抗他的新世界里，他能做的最好的事情，就是引导他所厌恶的事情，使其变成他稍微不那么厌恶的事情。

sentences.en: So this does not sound like it's going super well for Speaker McCarthy.
sentences.zh: 所以这听起来对麦卡锡议长来说进展得并不顺利。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: The best he can do in these situations is kind of mitigate the damage.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他能做的最好的事就是尽量减轻损失。

sentences.en: And that's what he's done, and he knows every day that his troubles are not behind him and are only probably getting worse.
sentences.zh: 他确实是这么做的，而且他每天都知道，自己的麻烦并没有结束，甚至可能还在恶化。

sentences.en: And what happens the same week as the Schiff's censure is McCarthy has to do this all over again when another member surprises him with a privileged resolution.
sentences.zh: 就在谴责希夫的那一周，麦卡锡又不得不重蹈覆辙，因为另一位议员用一项特权决议让他措手不及。

sentences.en: And this time the stakes are even higher.
sentences.zh: 而这一次，赌注更高了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning, and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: Celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 庆祝175年来，我们一直致力于帮助您了解世界，充实每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: So, Annie, tell us about this next unpleasant surprise that Speaker McCarthy encounters from his Republican colleagues.
sentences.zh: 那么，安妮，跟我们说说麦卡锡议长从共和党同僚那里遇到的下一个不愉快的惊喜吧。

sentences.en: The next thing that happens that same week is another member of the far-right Freedom Caucus.
sentences.zh: 同一周发生的下一件事是极右翼“自由核心小组”的另一位成员（采取了行动）。

sentences.en: Gentlewoman is recognized for six minutes.
sentences.zh: 这位女士有六分钟的发言时间。

sentences.en: This time it's Lauren Boebert of Colorado.
sentences.zh: 这次是来自科罗拉多州的劳伦·博伯特。

sentences.en: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of my impeachment bill that will hold Joe Biden accountable for the dereliction of one of his most basic duties.
sentences.zh: 议长先生，我今天起立支持我的弹劾法案，该法案将追究乔·拜登玩忽职守的责任，他未能履行最基本的职责之一。

sentences.en: She brings a privileged resolution to the floor.
sentences.zh: 她向众议院提交了一项特权决议。

sentences.en: For the first time in 24 years, a House Republican-led majority is moving forward with impeachment proceedings against a current president.
sentences.zh: 24年来，共和党领导的众议院多数派首次推进针对现任总统的弹劾程序。

sentences.en: And this time it's introducing articles of impeachment against Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 而这一次，是提出针对乔·拜登的弹劾条款。

sentences.en: She also gives no one a heads up that she's planning to do this.
sentences.zh: 她事先也没有通知任何人她打算这么做。

sentences.en: And what grounds does Congresswoman Boebert cite for introducing articles of impeachment?
sentences.zh: 那么博伯特众议员以什么理由提出弹劾条款呢？

sentences.en: The Biden border crisis and massive wave of illegal immigration has fueled a record-breaking fentanyl crisis.
sentences.zh: 拜登的边境危机和大规模非法移民浪潮助长了创纪录的芬太尼危机。

sentences.en: She claims that he deserves to be impeached because he has failed to secure the southern border.
sentences.zh: 她声称他应该被弹劾，因为他未能守住南部边境。

sentences.en: And that he has knowingly failed to enforce immigration laws.
sentences.zh: 而且他明知故犯，未能执行移民法。

sentences.en: His actions and open borders agenda demonstrate that he has no intention of enforcing our current immigration and border security statutes on the books.
sentences.zh: 他的行动和开放边境的议程表明，他根本无意执行我们现有的移民和边境安全法规。

sentences.en: She doesn't exactly lay out proof of high crimes and misdemeanors that is typically the bar for impeaching a president.
sentences.zh: 她并没有明确列出通常作为弹劾总统门槛的“重罪和轻罪”证据。

sentences.en: Every member should vote to hold President Joe Biden accountable.
sentences.zh: 每一位议员都应该投票追究乔·拜登总统的责任。

sentences.en: Mr. Speaker, I yield.
sentences.zh: 议长先生，我让出时间。

sentences.en: Gentlewoman yields back.
sentences.zh: 该女士收回发言时间。

sentences.en: I mean, that's about as big as it gets.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这已经是天大的事了。

sentences.en: Impeaching a president, she wants to do that without consulting with the Speaker of the House.
sentences.zh: 弹劾总统，她想在不咨询众议院议长的情况下就这么做。

sentences.en: Yes, without going through committees, without building a case.
sentences.zh: 是的，不经过委员会，不建立案件基础。

sentences.en: It's unheard of.
sentences.zh: 这简直闻所未闻。

sentences.en: And most of her colleagues are livid about this and think it's basically like a stunt impeachment.
sentences.zh: 她的大多数同僚对此感到愤怒，认为这基本上就是一场弹劾作秀。

sentences.en: But, you know, a lot of Republicans talked about impeaching Biden during the campaign.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，很多共和党人在竞选期间谈论过弹劾拜登。

sentences.en: And here she is delivering on that promise.
sentences.zh: 而她现在正在兑现那个承诺。

sentences.en: It also strikes me that this feels a lot like the censure of Adam Schiff in that it's a privileged resolution
sentences.zh: 我也觉得这很像对亚当·希夫的谴责，因为它是一项特权决议，

sentences.en: that feels like it has a lot to do with avenging the enemies of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 感觉这很大程度上是为了替唐纳德·特朗普报复政敌。

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And it comes on the heels of Trump being indicted by the Justice Department, which, you know, has Republicans railing against a two-tiered justice system.
sentences.zh: 而且这紧随特朗普被司法部起诉之后，你知道，这让共和党人对“双重标准”的司法体系大加抨击。

sentences.en: The House is the one branch of government that they still control.
sentences.zh: 众议院是他们仍然控制的唯一政府部门。

sentences.en: And so a few of them have decided that this is the most productive way to get back.
sentences.zh: 所以他们中的一些人认为这是反击最有效的方式。

sentences.en: To impeach President Biden.
sentences.zh: 弹劾拜登总统。

sentences.en: Without a real sense of what crimes he committed, yes.
sentences.zh: 在没有真正意识到他犯了什么罪的情况下，是的。

sentences.en: So what does Speaker McCarthy do in this case?
sentences.zh: 那么麦卡锡议长在这种情况下会怎么做？

sentences.en: What is his response to this privileged resolution act of rebellion?
sentences.zh: 他对这次特权决议的叛乱行为有什么回应？

sentences.en: This is a terrible position for him and for most of the members in his conference.
sentences.zh: 这对麦卡锡以及他党团中的大多数成员来说，是一个糟糕的处境。

sentences.en: McCarthy is very aware that impeachment is unpopular with voters.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡非常清楚，弹劾在选民中并不受欢迎。

sentences.en: And he tries to convince them that this is not how you do a real impeachment.
sentences.zh: 他试图说服他们，这不是进行真正弹劾的方式。

sentences.en: You don't do it in two days.
sentences.zh: 你不能在两天内完成。

sentences.en: You build a real case.
sentences.zh: 你需要建立一个真正的案件。

sentences.en: You present the case to voters to convince them that there were really crimes that need to be prosecuted.
sentences.zh: 你需要向选民陈述案情，让他们相信确实存在需要起诉的罪行。

sentences.en: He tells them in their closed-door conference meeting, you know, like, we vote on this.
sentences.zh: 他在闭门党团会议上告诉他们，你知道，比如，我们对此进行投票。

sentences.en: We send this over to the Senate.
sentences.zh: 我们把它送到参议院。

sentences.en: It has no chance of passage in a Democrat-controlled Senate.
sentences.zh: 在民主党控制的参议院里，它没有任何通过的机会。

sentences.en: And he kind of tells them, like, is this the majority we want to be?
sentences.zh: 他有点像是在问他们，这就是我们想成为的多数派吗？

sentences.en: If this is how we want to be, like, we're going to be a two-year majority.
sentences.zh: 如果我们想这样，那我们只能做两年的多数派。

sentences.en: We're going to lose control of the House.
sentences.zh: 我们将失去对众议院的控制权。

sentences.en: Well, can you explain that?
sentences.zh: 你能解释一下吗？

sentences.en: What does he mean exactly?
sentences.zh: 他到底是什么意思？

sentences.en: He means that this looks like a joke.
sentences.zh: 他的意思是这看起来像个笑话。

sentences.en: It looks like a political stunt.
sentences.zh: 这看起来像是一场政治作秀。

sentences.en: And it doesn't resonate with voters.
sentences.zh: 而且它无法引起选民的共鸣。

sentences.en: Voters care about the economy.
sentences.zh: 选民关心经济。

sentences.en: They care about inflation.
sentences.zh: 他们关心通货膨胀。

sentences.en: They care about the cost of a gallon of milk.
sentences.zh: 他们关心一加仑牛奶的价格。

sentences.en: Voters want lawmakers looking like they're doing serious work that affects their lives.
sentences.zh: 选民希望立法者看起来是在做影响他们生活的正经工作。

sentences.en: And I think McCarthy is trying to say here, doing a flimsy impeachment where we haven't even laid out the case to voters of why we have proof of high crimes and misdemeanors,
sentences.zh: 我认为麦卡锡在这里想表达的是，进行一场薄弱的弹劾，甚至没有向选民说明为什么我们有重罪和轻罪的证据，

sentences.en: that's how you squander your majority.
sentences.zh: 这就是挥霍你们的多数席位。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's saying this is how we lose the next election.
sentences.zh: 他是说这就是我们输掉下次选举的方式。

sentences.en: This is how a four-seat Republican majority becomes a Democratic majority by pulling things like this.
sentences.zh: 这就是共和党四个席位的多数优势如何变成民主党多数优势的方式，通过搞这些事情。

sentences.en: So he's saying don't do it.
sentences.zh: 所以他是说别这么做。

sentences.en: He's saying don't do it.
sentences.zh: 他是说别这么做。

sentences.en: The problem is some of the people he's saying that to likely don't care if they're in the majority or in the minority.
sentences.zh: 问题是，他劝说的那些人中，有些人可能根本不在乎他们是多数派还是少数派。

sentences.en: If you think about a bomb thrower or someone who is really not here because they want to legislate,
sentences.zh: 如果你想到一个“炸弹投掷者”，或者一个根本不是因为想立法而来到这里的人，

sentences.en: but because they want to get attention or disrupt how government works, you can do that from either side.
sentences.zh: 而是因为他们想博取关注或破坏政府运作，无论在哪一方你都可以这样做。

sentences.en: So he has a good argument that resonates with a lot of members, but a lot of members couldn't care less.
sentences.zh: 所以他的论点很有道理，能引起许多议员的共鸣，但也有很多议员根本不在乎。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I'm guessing Congresswoman Boeber is one of those lawmakers who couldn't care less.
sentences.zh: 我猜博伯特众议员就是那些根本不在乎的立法者之一。

sentences.en: But what does she say in response to this plea?
sentences.zh: 但她对这个恳求有什么回应？

sentences.en: Well, she does end up finding a deal with McCarthy, which is that they will take a vote
sentences.zh: 嗯，她最终确实与麦卡锡达成了一项协议，那就是他们将进行投票，

sentences.en: which would refer her impeachment articles to two powerful committees, to the Homeland Security
sentences.zh: 将她的弹劾条款提交给两个强有力的委员会，即国土安全委员会

sentences.en: Committee and to the Judiciary Committee, where they will investigate these border issues, these immigration issues, and take up the issue of impeachment through a committee.
sentences.zh: 和司法委员会，在那里他们将调查这些边境问题、移民问题，并通过委员会处理弹劾问题。

sentences.en: So she gets to save face and say, I got the ball rolling on a Biden impeachment, which is something that we've talked about for months.
sentences.zh: 所以她保住了面子，可以说，我启动了对拜登的弹劾，这是我们讨论了几个月的事情。

sentences.en: Now we have committees really looking into it.
sentences.zh: 现在我们有委员会在真正调查它了。

sentences.en: McCarthy got to head off a painful vote for members and did not actually have to do an impeachment vote on the House floor.
sentences.zh: 麦卡锡成功避免了让成员们进行痛苦的投票，实际上也不必在众议院全体会议上进行弹劾投票。

sentences.en: And a lot of times the way people kind of bury legislation they don't want to deal with is just to refer it to committees.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，人们掩盖他们不想处理的立法的方式就是将其提交给委员会。

sentences.en: So I've heard from a lot of moderate Republicans who hope that this is the last we ever hear
sentences.zh: 所以我从很多温和派共和党人那里听说，他们希望这是我们最后一次听到

sentences.en: of Boebert's impeachment articles, and they just die a quiet death in the Homeland Security and Judiciary Committees.
sentences.zh: 博伯特的弹劾条款，让它们在国土安全和司法委员会中悄无声息地死去。

sentences.en: We'll see.
sentences.zh: 我们走着瞧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's always the chance that those articles of impeachment come out of that committee and are referred to the full House.
sentences.zh: 总是有可能那些弹劾条款会从委员会出来并提交给众议院全体会议。

sentences.en: I mean, Annie, once again, if we think about McCarthy's playbook here, it feels like his best option, as with the Schiff censure, was to water down an act of rebellion here once
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，安妮，再一次，如果我们考虑麦卡锡的策略，感觉他最好的选择，就像处理希夫谴责案一样，是再次淡化这种叛乱行为，

sentences.en: again, rather than truly snuff it out.
sentences.zh: 而不是真正将其扑灭。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: He, again, kind of found a way to divert this to make it less painful for his members, to make it less painful for himself, to make it less embarrassing for Republicans.
sentences.zh: 他再次找到了一种方法来转移注意力，使这对他的成员来说不那么痛苦，对他自己来说不那么痛苦，让共和党人少一点尴尬。

sentences.en: But still, what did we do this last week in the House?
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，我们上周在众议院做了什么？

sentences.en: We covered them considering impeachment articles brought by one of the far-right members of
sentences.zh: 我们报道了他们审议由党团中极右翼成员提出的弹劾条款，

sentences.en: the conference who are dictating what the business on the floor is this week, as they did when they shut it down completely.
sentences.zh: 这些成员正在左右本周众议院的议程，就像他们之前完全关闭众议院时一样。

sentences.en: So he's doing the best he can in each one of these cases.
sentences.zh: 所以他在每一个案例中都在尽力而为。

sentences.en: It's almost like playing whack-a-mole, trying to put each one of these down in a way that causes him and the conference the least pain.
sentences.zh: 这简直就像在玩“打地鼠”，试图以一种对他和党团伤害最小的方式平息每一个事件。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Annie, this all feels like the precise scenario that so many political observers and our colleagues at The Times predicted might come to pass, given the math of this Congress, that
sentences.zh: 安妮，这一切感觉就像许多政治观察家和我们在《时报》的同事所预测的那样，考虑到本届国会的数学关系，

sentences.en: the Republican majority would be so small that it would empower a few of these firebrands,
sentences.zh: 共和党的多数优势将如此微弱，以至于它会赋予像你提到的劳伦·博伯特这样的煽动者权力，

sentences.en: like your Lauren Boeberts, whose actions would color how voters view the entire Republican
sentences.zh: 他们的行为会影响选民对整个共和党的看法。

sentences.en: Party.
sentences.zh: 党。

sentences.en: And you mentioned that McCarthy worries aloud that this is going to result in Republicans losing the House.
sentences.zh: 你提到麦卡锡大声担心这会导致共和党失去众议院。

sentences.en: I'm kind of curious, based on your reporting, if that's a widely held view, that this campaign
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，根据你的报道，这是否是一种广泛持有的观点，即这场复仇运动，

sentences.en: of vengeance, this mutiny against McCarthy, if it really is seen as something that is a perilous political path for the Republicans.
sentences.zh: 这场针对麦卡锡的兵变，是否真的被视为共和党一条危险的政治道路。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I mean, I think there's a lot of concern among Republicans who work on the Hill, who work around the Hill, that they could lose the House majority next year.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为在国会山工作、在国会山周围工作的共和党人中，有很多人担心他们明年可能会失去众议院的多数席位。

sentences.en: And this is exactly the kind of behavior and the kind of bills that will ensure that.
sentences.zh: 而这正是那种行为和那种法案，会确保这一点发生。

sentences.en: And this kind of behavior is exactly what makes them all so livid at members like Lauren Boebert.
sentences.zh: 而这种行为正是让他们所有人都对劳伦·博伯特这样的议员感到愤怒的原因。

sentences.en: If McCarthy is right, and these far-right House members are putting the entire party on a very dangerous political path, what can McCarthy do about it?
sentences.zh: 如果麦卡锡是对的，这些极右翼众议员正在把整个党带上一条非常危险的政治道路，麦卡锡能对此做些什么？

sentences.en: I mean, it sounds like there's not much he can do, but are there any options?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听起来他能做的并不多，但还有其他选择吗？

sentences.en: I assume he doesn't want to be the Republican speaker who barely got elected in the first place
sentences.zh: 我假设他不想成为那个本来就勉强当选的共和党议长，

sentences.en: and then oversees a two-year narrow Republican majority, but that is what he is openly worrying is about to happen.
sentences.zh: 然后监督一个为期两年的微弱共和党多数派，但这正是他公开担心即将发生的事情。

sentences.en: Yes, he's openly worrying about that possibility.
sentences.zh: 是的，他公开担心这种可能性。

sentences.en: And I think he doesn't think particularly long-term like that.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他并没有考虑那么长远。

sentences.en: I think he's on a day-to-day whack-a-mole lifestyle right now where he has to deal with the fire in front of him, and his M.O.
sentences.zh: 我认为他现在过着一种“打地鼠”的日常生活，他必须处理眼前的火，他的行事风格

sentences.en: is like live another day, survive another day.
sentences.zh: 就是过一天算一天，多生存一天。

sentences.en: I think that he does still have a lot of confidence from a large majority of his members who think
sentences.zh: 我认为他仍然得到了大多数成员的很大信任，他们认为

sentences.en: like this is an impossible situation, and it's not exactly clear who could be handling this any better.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不可能的局面，而且也不清楚谁能处理得更好。

sentences.en: It's a terrible job, a terrible dynamic, and he doesn't have much control.
sentences.zh: 这是一份糟糕的工作，一种糟糕的动态，他没有多少控制权。

sentences.en: So Annie, what is going to be the next chapter of this saga for the House Republicans?
sentences.zh: 那么安妮，众议院共和党人这场传奇故事的下一章会是什么？

sentences.en: The next chapter of this saga becomes a lot more serious.
sentences.zh: 这场传奇故事的下一章会变得严肃得多。

sentences.en: When Congress comes back from their recess that they start this week, they have some actual serious business before them, like passing important spending bills, funding the
sentences.zh: 当国会从本周开始的休会期回来时，他们面前有一些真正严肃的事务，比如通过重要的支出法案，为政府提供资金，

sentences.en: government, staving off a government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 避免政府停摆。

sentences.en: So the stakes are going to matter.
sentences.zh: 所以赌注将变得很重要。

sentences.en: So what's going to happen is McCarthy's going to be dealing with this same dynamic where he's playing whack-a-mole every day.
sentences.zh: 所以接下来会发生的是，麦卡锡将不得不处理同样的动态，他每天都在玩“打地鼠”。

sentences.en: And he's going to be dealing with the same lack of trust and anger that all grew out of the debt-selling deal he forged with Biden, while also have to pass really important bills.
sentences.zh: 他将不得不处理同样的缺乏信任和愤怒，这些都源于他与拜登达成的债务上限协议，同时还必须通过非常重要的法案。

sentences.en: That's what awaits him after recess.
sentences.zh: 这就是休会后等待他的东西。

sentences.en: Sounds like a dream for him.
sentences.zh: 听起来对他来说是个梦想。

sentences.en: Dream job.
sentences.zh: 梦想工作。

sentences.en: Well, Annie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，安妮，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Next week, when the House returns from recess, Republicans are expected to consider a set of resolutions, both introduced by far-right members, that would seek to expunge the two
sentences.zh: 下周，当众议院从休会期回来时，预计共和党人将审议一系列决议，这些决议均由极右翼成员提出，旨在寻求撤销对前总统特朗普的两次

sentences.en: impeachments of former President Trump on the grounds that the original cases against him were unconstitutional.
sentences.zh: 弹劾，理由是针对他的原始案件违宪。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, in his first public remarks since a rebellion against his government was called
sentences.zh: 周一，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京发表了针对其政府的叛乱平息以来的首次公开讲话，

sentences.en: off, Russian President Vladimir Putin said that the revolt failed because, quote, the entire
sentences.zh: 他表示叛乱之所以失败，是因为引用他的话，“整个

sentences.en: Russian society united.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯社会团结一致”。

sentences.en: The speech appeared to be aimed at projecting unity and stability after the most serious challenge to Putin's power in decades.
sentences.zh: 这次讲话似乎旨在展现团结与稳定，以应对普京几十年来权力受到的最严峻挑战。

sentences.en: But in it, he offered a major concession to members of the militia who staged the rebellion,
sentences.zh: 但在讲话中，他向发动叛乱的民兵成员做出了重大让步，

sentences.en: saying that if they wished, they could move to neighboring Belarus and rejoin their leader,
sentences.zh: 称如果他们愿意，可以前往邻国白俄罗斯，与他们的领导人重聚，

sentences.en: Yevgeny Prigozhin, who led the rebellion.
sentences.zh: 即领导了这次叛乱的叶夫根尼·普里戈任。

sentences.en: Anne.
sentences.zh: 安妮。

sentences.en: On Monday night, CNN published an audio recording from 2021 in which former President Trump shared
sentences.zh: 周一晚间，美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）发布了一段2021年的录音，录音中前总统特朗普向没有安全许可的作者分享了

sentences.en: classified information about a possible plan of attack against Iran with writers who lacked security clearances.
sentences.zh: 关于针对伊朗的潜在攻击计划的机密信息。

sentences.en: The recording has become a centerpiece of the special counsel's indictment against Trump for taking classified documents from the White House and refusing to return them.
sentences.zh: 这段录音已成为特别检察官起诉特朗普的核心证据，指控他从白宫带走机密文件并拒绝归还。

sentences.en: In the recording, Trump acknowledges to those in the room that the material he's showing off is highly sensitive and explicitly states that he had not declassified them.
sentences.zh: 在录音中，特朗普向在场人员承认他展示的材料高度敏感，并明确表示他并未将这些文件解密。

sentences.en: Since the president, I couldn't declassify them.
sentences.zh: 当时我是总统，我无法将它们解密。

sentences.en: Now I can't.
sentences.zh: 现在我不能了。

sentences.en: But this is so cool.
sentences.zh: 但这太酷了。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《Metro》节目中，我们将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。
